# Mesmos

> > Mesmos is a curated wellness and mindfulness gift shop offering thoughtfully designed stationery, self-care products, and inspirational items for personal growth and recovery.

Mesmos specializes in meaningful gifts centered around wellness, mindfulness, and personal development. The product range spans pen sets with artistic designs (Pastel, Van Gogh, Midnight series), daily calendars with philosophical themes, self-care products like shower steamers, and decorative home items—all designed to support mental health, sobriety, and intentional living.

## Key Topics

- Mindfulness products
- Wellness gifts
- Stoicism
- Self-care
- Pen sets
- Daily calendars
- Recovery support

- Stationery shop

- Mindfulness cards
